title: Win probability derived from the margin regressor: p = Phi(margin / sigma)
motivation: Each model's classifier (win prob, pick) and regressor (margin) are trained separately and point at different teams on 20-57% of early 2026-27 games (project_head_disagreement). Deriving the probability from the margin makes the two agree by construction. Question: does it cost pick accuracy or probability quality?

data.windows: calendar months from 2023-10, gated >=50 test / >=800 train (harness.month_windows)

arms.clf_raw: classifier predict_proba, uncalibrated (production pick for all families; production display for RF/NN)
arms.clf_iso: eval-slice isotonic on the classifier (production display for XGB)
arms.phi_mle: PRIMARY. Phi(m / s), s fit by 1-parameter probit MLE (no intercept) on the eval slice (last 20% of train, models refit on first 80%)
arms.phi_resid: Phi(m / s), s = SD of regressor residuals on the same eval slice

pooling: per game: probabilities and margins averaged over seeds, then pooled across all windows; per-seed direction consistency reported alongside

gates.comparison: phi_mle vs the family's production probability (RF: clf_raw, NN: clf_raw, XGB: clf_iso) for log loss/Brier/ECE; phi_mle pick (= sign of margin) vs clf_raw pick for accuracy
adopt_family_if_all: pooled accuracy delta: 95% paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > -0.010 (non-inferior within 1.0pp)
pooled log-loss delta: 95% paired-bootstrap CI upper bound < +0.005
no test significant AGAINST phi_mle at p<0.05 (McNemar on picks, paired bootstrap on log loss and Brier, bootstrap AUC)
gates.decision: Recommendation only. Adoption (production code change) is Kai's call; a family failing the gate keeps the classifier.
secondary_descriptive: phi_resid vs phi_mle (does the simpler sigma suffice)
incumbent split rate (clf_raw pick != margin sign) by window
early-season (Oct-Nov windows) vs rest: split rate and the accuracy/log-loss deltas

live_leg.added_at: 2026-11-13, before any backtest or live result was read
live_leg.source: public API /api/performance/results (read-only GET), regular-season GAME_IDs only; fetched rows frozen to outputs/e27_live_rows.json
live_leg.fit: sigma per model by the same probit MLE on graded 2025-26 rows (walk-forward, E26)
live_leg.test: graded 2026-27 rows: Phi(logged predicted_margin / sigma) vs the logged home_win_probability (what the site shows: RF/NN raw, XGB calibrated); pick = margin sign vs logged predicted_winner
live_leg.gates: same three checks as the backtest, reported per model; n is ~170 games per model, so the live leg can flag a problem but cannot by itself establish non-inferiority. The backtest decides; the live leg must not show a significant regression.
live_leg.descriptive: split rate by week of 2026-27 vs Oct-Nov 2025 and the rest of 2025-26 (does the early-season spike decay?)

known_limitation: Frozen snapshot ends with the 2025-26 Finals, so it holds no 2026-27 games: early-season behaviour is read from the Oct/Nov windows of 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.
